**Subject:** Request for Review of Travel Expense Discrepancies

Dear Customer Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to bring to your attention several discrepancies I have noticed in my recent travel expense records. As a frequent traveler and a valued customer, accurate accounting of these expenses is essential for both my personal budgeting and compliance with corporate travel policies.

**Summary of Issues**

| Date | Expense Category | Recorded Amount | Expected Amount | Notes |
|------|------------------|-----------------|-----------------|-------|
| 2024‑05‑12 | Flight (Economy) | $650 | $620 | Ticket price appears inflated |
| 2024‑05‑13 | Hotel (Standard) | $480 | $450 | Room rate higher than quoted |
| 2024‑05‑14 | Airport Transfer | $120 | $100 | Additional surcharge not disclosed |
| 2024‑05‑15 | Travel Insurance | $1,500 | $1,500 | Invoice missing; payment confirmed |

**Key Points**

1. **Flight & Hotel Charges** – The amounts charged for my flight and hotel stay exceed the rates I was quoted during booking. I have attached screenshots of the original booking confirmations for reference.
2. **Airport Transfer** – An unexpected surcharge of $20 was added to my transfer fee. I was not informed of this additional cost at the time of booking.
3. **Travel Insurance** – While the payment of $1,500 was processed successfully, I have not received the corresponding invoice. This omission is problematic for my expense reporting and audit purposes.

**Attachments**

- Booking confirmation for flight (PDF)
- Hotel reservation confirmation (PDF)
- Screenshot of transfer booking (PNG)
- Payment receipt for insurance (PDF)

**Requested Actions**

- Please review the above discrepancies and provide corrected invoices or receipts where applicable.
- Clarify the policy regarding additional surcharges for airport transfers and confirm whether these charges are standard practice.
- Expedite the issuance of the missing insurance invoice and confirm the transaction details.

I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. If you require any further documentation or clarification, please let me know at your earliest convenience.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Employee/Account ID]  
[Contact Phone]  
[Email Address]
